title: VORTEX-G: Anti-Gravity Racing & Track Editor
description:
ABOUT THIS GAMEVORTEX-G is a high-speed journey back to the golden age of futuristic racing. Inspired by the legends of the 90s and early 2000s, it blends blistering anti-gravity competition with a deep creative suite and a unique urban exploration twist.

Whether you are a speed freak, a master architect, or a digital explorer, VORTEX-G offers a neon-soaked universe where your skills, and your imagination, set the limits.

KEY FEATURES• Massive Racing Content: Master 117 unique official circuits designed to test your reflexes and your command of zero-G physics across diverse environments.

• Championship Glory: Rise through the ranks in 9 high-stakes Arcade Tournaments. Each cup is a multi-race challenge that will push your reflexes to the limit.

• The Hall of Trophies: Your victories deserve a pedestal. Unlock 9 unique legendary trophies as you conquer each tournament. Head to the Workshop to inspect your collection in a full 360-degree view, admiring every detail of your hard-earned glory.

• Intuitive Track Editor: Don't just race—create. Build death-defying tracks using the same powerful tools used by the developers. The only limit is your creativity. 
 
 

• The "Taxi & Exploration" Twist: Step out of the cockpit! For the first time in the genre, explore a vast, intricate megacity on foot or by ship.

• Taxi Mode: Take on missions to transport citizens through the neon-lit streets.

• Orb Hunting: Find hidden orbs tucked away in hard-to-reach places through precision platforming.

• 

• Unlockable Anime Art Gallery: Your exploration has rewards. Use the orbs you collect to unlock an exclusive in-game gallery featuring stunning anime-style character art and illustrations.

• Deep Craft Customization: Design your identity from the ground up. Customize everything from the cockpit glass to individual winglets and fuselage sections. Add your custom name and race number to truly own the grid.

• Tailored for Pilots: While the Workshop offers deep technical tools for precision editing, the entire racing experience and menu navigation are fully optimized for Controller Support, ensuring you never lose your flow at breakneck speeds.

• Retro-Futuristic Aesthetic: Immerse yourself in a vibrant, low-poly cyberpunk world that captures the raw energy and aesthetic of the 32-bit era classics.

Buckle up, pilot. The future of racing is in your hands.
description_short: VORTEX-G: High-speed anti-gravity racing. Master 117 official tracks or craft your own with the powerful built-in editor. Explore a vast futuristic city on foot or by ship in Taxi Mode, collect hidden orbs, and unlock an exclusive anime art gallery.. A tribute to the golden age of futuristic racers.
